questions.q: What was Thailand called before 1939?
questions.why: The new name means 'land of the free'.

questions.q: Which is the only Southeast Asian country never colonised by Europeans?
questions.why: Skilful diplomacy kept it independent.

questions.q: Which old capital was destroyed by Burmese armies in 1767?
questions.why: Its ruins are a UNESCO site.

questions.q: Which kingdom is seen as the first Thai kingdom?
questions.why: Its name means 'dawn of happiness'.

questions.q: Which king reigned for 70 years until 2016?
questions.why: He was then the world's longest-reigning monarch.

questions.q: Which dynasty has ruled Thailand since 1782?
questions.why: Its kings are also called Rama.

questions.q: In which year did Siam become a constitutional monarchy?
questions.why: A bloodless revolution ended absolute monarchy.

questions.q: Which king, shown in 'The King and I', opened Siam to Western learning?
questions.why: He was also a keen astronomer.

questions.q: Which king abolished slavery and modernised Siam?
questions.why: 23 October is Chulalongkorn Day.

questions.q: Which king refounded the kingdom at Thonburi after 1767?
questions.why: He is honoured on 28 December.

questions.q: Which Sukhothai king is credited with creating the Thai script?
questions.why: His inscription is dated 1292.

questions.q: Which northern kingdom had its capital at Chiang Mai?
questions.why: King Mengrai founded it.

questions.q: Which king of Ayutthaya won a famous elephant duel in 1593?
questions.why: He defeated a Burmese crown prince.

questions.q: Which wartime railway built with prisoners of war is called the 'Death Railway'?
questions.why: The bridge over the River Kwai is part of it.

questions.q: Who became Thailand's first woman Prime Minister, in 2011?
questions.why: Her brother Thaksin had also been Prime Minister.

questions.q: What is the capital of Thailand?
questions.why: Thais call it Krung Thep.

questions.q: Which stir-fried rice noodle dish is a Thai classic?
questions.why: It became popular in the 1930s and 40s.

questions.q: Which April festival is famous for water fights?
questions.why: It marks the Thai New Year.

questions.q: Which festival floats decorated baskets on rivers?
questions.why: It falls on the full moon of the 12th lunar month.

questions.q: Which combat sport is Thailand's national sport?
questions.why: It is called the 'art of eight limbs'.

questions.q: What is Thailand's currency?
questions.why: Its symbol is ฿.

questions.q: Which is Thailand's largest island?
questions.why: It is in the Andaman Sea.

questions.q: Which hot and sour soup is often made with prawns?
questions.why: UNESCO listed it in 2024.

questions.q: Which Bangkok temple houses the Emerald Buddha?
questions.why: It is in the Grand Palace grounds.

questions.q: Which Bangkok temple is famous for its giant reclining Buddha?
questions.why: The Buddha is 46 m long.

questions.q: Which river flows through Bangkok?
questions.why: It is called the 'River of Kings'.

questions.q: Which northern city is famous for releasing sky lanterns at Yi Peng?
questions.why: It was the Lanna capital.

questions.q: Which curry noodle soup is a northern Thai speciality?
questions.why: It is topped with crispy noodles.

questions.q: What is Thailand's highest mountain?
questions.why: It is 2,565 m high.

questions.q: Which islands were the setting of the film 'The Beach'?
questions.why: It was filmed at Maya Bay.
